# Hourly log-anomaly scan

## Objective
Surface unusual log patterns to @sre-oncall within the hour.

## Inputs and freshness
Read application logs for the last 60 minutes.

## Procedure
1. Fetch the window's logs.

Post findings to #sre-alerts.

If no pattern exceeds the threshold, finalize quietly without posting. If the log source cannot be reached, retry once after 60 seconds; if the retry also fails, notify @sre-oncall and finalize as failed with the error.

## Done when
Either findings are posted or the run finalized quietly.

# Weekly numbers

## Objective
Publish last week's headline metrics to the public changelog.

## Inputs and freshness
Read the metrics tab of the company spreadsheet.

## Procedure
1. Read MRR, signups and churn from the named cells.
2. Format them into the changelog entry template.

## Output and delivery
Publish the entry to the public changelog.

## Failure and no-result behavior
If a cell is empty, publish the entry with that metric omitted.

## Done when
The entry is published.

Follow up with vendors who have not returned a signed contract.

## Failure and no-result behavior
If every contract is signed, finalize quietly.

Follow-ups are sent and the list is posted.
